comment: Plan F3 Task 5: reference mode (r.ReferenceMode=1, spec K-B) vs the committed glTF-Sample-Viewer references tests/golden/ref/sample-viewer/<asset>.png (tools/refgen, settings.json). Scene = the file refgen rendered (settings.json models[].variant / file). pngChannels 3: the references are RGB (refgen; the Sample-Viewer canvas has alpha: false). Thresholds: plan F3 Task 5 gate mean FLIP <= 0.05; a case may only be lowered below that gate with a reason naming the formula difference found, never above 0.10 without a BLOCKED worklist entry.

cases.name: BrainStem.glTF-Meshopt-EXT.vulkan
cases.thresholdReason: plan F3 Task 6 default gate (mean FLIP <= 0.05)
cases.expectedFail: file-specific fit camera: this variant's POSITION accessors carry quantized min / max under dequantizing node transforms, so getExtentsFromAccessor (which the renderer ports) gives a larger box, (-1.62, -0.47, -1.36) .. (1.26, 2.27, 1.30) vs the plain glTF's (-1.26, -0.11, -0.99) .. (1.21, 2.27, 0.91) (computed from the JSON), and the reference is the plain file's framing; the model is drawn smaller and lower. Mean FLIP 0.129 (plan F3 Task 6 run); the plain BrainStem cases pass.

cases.name: VirtualCity.glTF.vulkan
cases.thresholdReason: plan F3 Task 6 default gate (mean FLIP <= 0.05)
cases.expectedFail: Sample-Viewer limit (reference only): image 0 (001.jpg) is both baseColorTexture (sRGB) and occlusionTexture (linear) of the same materials; webgl.js setTexture uploads a glTF texture once, with the format of its first binding (gltfTex.initialized), and material.js initGl binds occlusion before baseColor, so the reference samples the base colour without the sRGB decode (washed-out yellow dome). The renderer decodes per slot (glTF 2.0, Review Focus 3): mean FLIP 0.115 vulkan / d3d11 (plan F3 Task 6 run). Not lowered into a threshold: above 0.10.
